staticFindings.area: control template and ROI tool choices
refs: Apps.XmlUI.ParamTabControl.RoiSelectControl: class exposes image width/height and CanUpDateROI dependency properties; XAML ROI type buttons bind ValueChangedCommand and expose ImageViewBox with DrawROIType, IsStateForDrawROI, RoiAddCommand, RoiSelectedCommand.
staticFindings.conclusion: The view layer supplies the control template and command bindings; behavior lives in ROISelecter and ImageViewBox, not the small code-behind.
staticFindings.unknown: Whether the displayed control in the requested Blob debug scenario is this exact template instance was not runtime-confirmed.

refs: ROIConfigControl.xaml binds RoiSelectControl.DataContext to IDecorate.DecorateSource; ImageViewBox binds ImageDataSource=ImageSource, ROIList, DrawROIType, IsStateForDrawROI, AddROICommand and selection command. ROIConfigControl code-behind moves ImageViewBox to FullScreen, ShowDialog, then removes it, clears DataContext and reattaches the child after normal dialog return.
staticFindings.conclusion: This is a Group ROI display/fullscreen panel connected through IDecorate.DecorateSource; it is a different UI semantic from the Blob public parameter GroupLink ROI configuration. It does not establish the Blob public-window caller or inheritance source.
staticFindings.unknown: Blob public parameter-window caller, top-level GroupLink expansion route, and actual close/error lifecycle are not established by this panel evidence. The framework ROI registration can be statically traced separately through Tab.OnXmlLoaded.

refs: RenderControlBase.xaml binds image list ComboBox ItemsSource=ImageViewList and SelectedItem=SelectedImage TwoWay; ParamsConfigWithRenderControlBase exposes SetSelectedImage/GetSelectedImageDisplayName and sends selected-image changes.
staticFindings.conclusion: This is a generic render-control display-image selector. It describes displayed-image selection, not the Blob algorithm input-image binding/source. It cannot establish which image the Blob algorithm receives.
staticFindings.unknown: Blob input source is declared through the shipped Blob/Group XML and must be followed through the existing Group binding-tree evidence; no UI selection or algorithm input was executed in this review.

refs: Blob Group.xml Region：候选树 GetFrontCombinationTreeOperation(ROIBOX)，CurValue trigger 调用 SetCombinationSourceOperation(InputROI)，初始化 GetSelectedCombinationOperation(InputROI)。该 operation 写 vmModule.GetIO(InputROI).RelateIO=GetIoByPathFromAround(selected path)，并按选中的 combination filter 设置 RelateIndex。
ROICenterX/ROICenterY/ROIWidth/ROIHeight/ROIAngle 等参数字段使用 GetFrontFilterTreeOperation(float) 与 SetFilterSourceOperation(field name)，这是参数/标量源订阅，不等同 ROI 字节序列化。
独立的 IGetROI.SetRoiList/GetRoiList 与 IUserBytesData[ComName] 是 ROI 模型列表编码/解码路径；不能把 InheritWayGroup2 选择值解释成该接口调用。
staticFindings.conclusion: 静态证据已建立两种不同传递：Region 以 ROIBOX 组合树选择来源，写到 Blob InputROI 的 VmIO.RelateIO/RelateIndex；ROICenterX 等按参数字段使用过滤树并设置 RelateIO。ROISelecter 的 GetRoiList/SetRoiList 另处理 ROI 列表字节序列化。已确认声明与关系设置，不声称实机当次选择或算法消费值已运行。
staticFindings.unknown: 运行时实际选择的来源、不同 InheritWay 数值下 ROI/参数模式的可见分支和值结果仍未测；Group.xml 的 InheritWayGroup2 声明本身不证明执行 IGetROI.SetRoiList。

refs: ROIStackControl data template sends selected CurROIData to the shape editor; BoxROIStack coordinate/size fields are TwoWay bindings to ROIData properties and OnStartValueChange calls ROIValueChangedCommand. ROISelecter.InitRoi installs DataChangedCommand; changes invoke RoiParamChange→SetValue→NormalizeReversParse→SetBinaryData→IUserBytesData[ComName], followed by sequence/image-size writes and PreExecuteRun when changed. UpdateROI reads current module bytes and applies decoded values to existing ROI objects while visible and CanUpdateROI.
